evidence.local_verification: 459 tests / 459 pass / 0 fail / 0 skipped; deterministic synthetic demo; real-mode error handling and credential redaction verified
evidence.p0_5_reason: P0.5 must prove that Beetlejuice learns a clean, high-confidence model of agentic automation architecture first. Cost is not the primary explanatory feature. Complete or partial real billing is attached tenant-locally as economic calibration/labels and may enter the global layer only as rights-cleared privacy-gated generalized labels. The canonical architecture model must remain useful without billing and accept later true billing without redesign.

architecture_learning_policy.primary_target: Learn which automation architectures/configurations produce accepted useful work with lower structural waste for defined task contexts.
architecture_learning_policy.relation: TASK_CONTEXT + AGENT_MODEL_CONFIG + AUTOMATION_ARCHITECTURE -> OUTCOME + LATENCY + STRUCTURAL_WASTE + RESOURCE_FOOTPRINT
architecture_learning_policy.unknowns: Unknown remains unknown. Inferred fields carry provenance/confidence and are never promoted silently to measured fact.
architecture_learning_policy.causality: Cross-sectional correlations are hypotheses, not causal proof. Preserve intervention/before-after labels for later local autotuning.

billing_evidence_policy.github_only: Architecture/outcome/waste remains useful where structurally defensible; never claim total dollars or total cost per outcome without monetary evidence.
billing_evidence_policy.partial: Compute only evidenced spend, label coverage and partiality, never extrapolate missing components.
billing_evidence_policy.complete: Only complete evidenced and attributable components may be labeled total measured economic cost and total cost per successful outcome.
billing_evidence_policy.role: Billing is a local calibration/economic-label layer attached to the architecture model, not the foundational architecture signal.

corpus_policy.primary: Small high-confidence architecture-learning corpus first. Prefer explicit agent/tool identity, recoverable task class, explicit or strongly constrained model/provider/configuration, defensible execution correlation, observable architecture topology/policy and observable outcome.
corpus_policy.secondary: Messy ambiguous repositories test abstention, pagination, failures and robustness only; do not promote ambiguous labels to ground truth.
corpus_policy.global_export: Only unlinkable privacy-gated abstract architecture/task/outcome/resource/economic labels may leave the tenant boundary where rights permit.

viability_paths.path_1: COMPLETE_ECONOMIC_LABELS: sufficiently attributed complete billing for a useful subset supports true measured total cost/outcome labels on architecture rows.
viability_paths.path_2: ARCHITECTURE_FIRST_CALIBRATION: clean architecture/outcome/resource rows are learnable before complete billing, and true billing can later attach as calibration labels without redefining the canonical model.

customer_value_model.without_full_billing: Explain the customer's automation architecture, outcomes and defensible structural inefficiencies; disclose missing monetary evidence.
customer_value_model.with_full_billing: Use the customer's actual model/tool/CI pricing and attributable usage to calculate true local cost/outcome and map dollars onto the architectural inefficiencies.
customer_value_model.future_global_model: Use consented unlinkable architecture/outcome rows progressively calibrated by generalized real billing labels to learn which architectures work under which task conditions.

p0_5_target.objective: real-world architecture learning plus local billing calibration viability gate

p1_target.objective: installable GitHub App prototype AFTER P0.5
requirements: under-five-minute target when sufficient history is available
